corpus: 100 generated Python files, 500 lines each; comment-heavy
baseline: one full 500-line module as UTF-8 bytes

index.analysis: Static candidates, not proof of runtime calls. Reindex after source changes.

limits: Byte reduction only. No tokenizer, LLM, answer-quality or end-to-end agent measurement. A call graph is less informative than source. Synthetic comments exaggerate compression.
